reuse.why: All new behaviour goes through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection, and the new action reuses averageToBudget, getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages; only group notes are read outside the existing notes store.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules are added once in the shared selection; the new action's per-category loop closely mirrors the existing average actions but is short.

placement.why: The exclusions sit in the right helper, but the #fixed check reads a new category_groups.notes column added to the AQL schema and DB type, while the tree keeps notes in the separate notes table keyed by id (server/notes/app.ts).

scope.why: Changes are mostly on-request, but replacing includeHidden with includeHiddenCategories also silently drops setZero's preserved 'writes every hidden category' variation and adds schema/type fields for group notes.

maintainability.why: One selection function owns the rules, which is good, but the combined boolean condition with an inline regex and the invented notes column make it fragile to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories reads g.notes from category_groups (new schema/type field) instead of the notes table / notes module that stores group notes.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; setLastMonthSpending shares selection and sign conversion with the existing actions.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories: includeHidden replaced by optional includeHiddenCategories; template and #fixed exclusions added as general rules; every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, calls the helper.
